limits: CPU restriction is artificial and not the shipping policy; sleep is not an uncontended baseline on a shared host.
The helper may also affect other eligible threads, SMT siblings, caches, power/frequency and thermal state; no pure scheduler-only or Ghostty-gap attribution.
Plain retains common producer-boundary profiling, so it is observer-free for reader clocks/proc, not fully uninstrumented throughput.
Neither observer neutrality, startup, memory, key latency, presentation latency, nor all-metric superiority follows from this experiment.
Residual remains unclassified off-CPU/accounting time, not pure blocking. No global sysctl changes, elevated privilege or unrelated-process tracing.
